scope: Actual AE malformed-request and native-plan guards; no pixel checks.

tests.name: A package with resources is refused before creating a layer
Malformed resource declarations are refused before creating a layer
Fractional star points are refused even when its radii are valid
Out-of-range star points remain refused without relying on descriptor limits
A null payload is refused even with a valid composition target
An array payload is refused even with a valid composition target
An empty operation is refused as a malformed request
An oversized operation is refused as a malformed request
A normal read-only request remains usable after malformed requests
